LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 14.3.1 SUBJECT- VERB AGREEMENT

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we construct sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the subject and the verb in sentences
2. construct sentences ensuring subject-verb agreement

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 14.3.1 SUBJECT- VERB AGREEMENT
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the subject and the verb in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. construct sentences ensuring subject-verb agreement
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement.
